Synopsis:
German Chancellor Merz confirmed Berlin is finalizing a coordinated response to a suspected drone attack on a Ukrainian military cargo plane at Leipzig/Halle airport (Aug 4). Die Welt reported Russia will be formally blamed, with EU-coordinated sanctions to follow. Merz stopped short of publicly naming Russia but confirmed alignment with EU and NATO partners on an imminent, joint response.
